required_pair_selection_rule: Each corpus unit must bind one distinct fetched Getty Activity payload to one distinct fetched Getty HumanMadeObject payload through an explicit transferred_title_of reference present in that Activity payload.
truth_boundary: This contract acquires 120 distinct Getty Activity to HumanMadeObject source pairs only when the fetched Activity explicitly carries part.transferred_title_of referencing the fetched object. Both fetched JSON-LD payloads are independently digested and Getty's API documentation plus its stated CC0 basis are retained as rights evidence. The corpus remains unlabeled and unpredicted empirical material; it does not infer ownership, identity, current-market truth, ER outcome, Track B approval, publication approval or Production approval.
